name: diff-view
title: DiffView
description: Controlled line-level text diff rendered as a semantic table over the pure diffLines LCS (no diff lib). Split (two columns, default) or unified (inline) via mode; every changed row carries a textual +/- marker plus data-diff (a11y, not color-alone); honest 'No changes' empty state; sr-only caption. Reuses cn + the diff core.
